answer: Require every agent to stake reputation earned through verified work before it can transact: a newcomer starts on the umber edge of trust, able only to observe, and climbs only by completing small, attested jobs whose results peers check. Like basalt layers forming slowly under pressure, this history cannot be faked in bulk — a thousand fresh identities buy no standing, because each must separately accumulate costly attestations. A sybil swarm stays stranded on the knoll outside the market, visible but unable to vote, grade, or move funds, while established agents trade on proven records.
